_howto: Elections polled by the Alabama SOS election-night adapter (server/src/adapters/alsos.js). ecode = the election code in statewideResultsByContest.aspx?ecode= (linked from https://www.sos.alabama.gov/alabama-votes). electionTitle = the page's '2026 GENERAL ELECTION' heading: nothing is stored while the ecode shows another election. Only page 1 of the statewide and county pages is read (later pages are ASP.NET postbacks), so allContests is false. Set enabled:false to stop polling.
